title: Idle unload never resets a newly started recording
steps: Start another recording as the idle unload expires
expected: The active recording or transcription retains its state when the previous unload completes.

title: Opening the practice guide brings it above a maximized browser
steps: Use tray > How to use / Practice
Confirm guide is visible in front
expected: Both openings make the guide visible immediately without requiring its taskbar button.
